title: Two errors in a row
prompt: This time there are two mistakes: a missing colon on the first line and a missing closing bracket on the second. Fix the first, run, read the next error, fix that too. The robot should print "Fixed".
hints: Godot reports one error at a time; fixing the first reveals the next.
First line needs a colon; second line needs a ).

docs.name: The error panel
docs.what: Godot's message plus the line it happened on, counted from the top of your code.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.
